verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee has no documented persistent browser profile. A developer can approximate one by passing saved cookies on each request with the `cookies` parameter and keeping the same IP across requests with `session_id`, but cookie and login state must be captured and re-sent by hand. missing for 10: a server-side persistent browser profile, automatic cookie and storage persistence between requests, documented login-state reuse, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
